system.description: When you would cast a Jutsu that would grant you Temporary Hit points, you can spend a superiority die. When you do, all allied creatures within 10 feet of you gain the benefit of the jutsu cast. If you would roll to determine the number of temporary hit points gained, you add the result of your Superiority die to the result.
